name: com.liminallabs.gameevents
description: ScriptableObject game events with AAA raise semantics: deterministic order, exception isolation, safe mid-raise mutation, recursion guard. Designer wiring via listener components and UnityEvents, plus the Events Board window with live activity, raise history, and project-wide reference scanning.

samples.description: One broadcaster, sixteen reactors, zero scene references: pulse waves, hue shifts from a single payload, and lamps toggled in code and via listener components. Materials use URP.
